name: Porto Book Fair
description: A fantastic outing for all ages. Beyond the books, the fair offers daily concerts, author talks, and engaging kids' activities like pop-up book making and story time sessions.
longDescription:
The Porto Book Fair is an annual literary event held in the city, organised by the Porto City Council. It serves as a platform for publishers, authors, and readers to connect, promoting literature and reading within the community. The fair features a wide selection of books across various genres and languages, presented by numerous participating bookstores and publishing houses.

Visitors to the fair can expect a lively atmosphere suitable for families. The event extends beyond book sales, incorporating a daily schedule of live music performances, discussions with authors, and dedicated activities for children. These include workshops focused on creating pop-up books and scheduled storytelling sessions. The fair takes place outdoors within the Jardins do Palácio de Cristal, offering a spacious setting for exploration.

Entry to the Porto Book Fair is free for all visitors. The Jardins do Palácio de Cristal are accessible via public transport, with several bus lines serving the area. It is also within walking distance from the city centre. The event is categorised as family-friendly, with activities designed to engage younger attendees.
